# Bali Astrology

> Authentic Vedic & KP Astrology insights, calculations, and online consultations by Pandit Rahul Bali Ji.

## Summary

Bali Astrology provides free, precise Vedic (Parashari) and Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) astrological tools, planetary transit tracking, daily Panchang calculations, and online birth chart readings. Maintained by Pandit Rahul Bali Ji, a practicing Vedic astrologer combining traditional Brahmin wisdom with modern analytical rigor.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://baliastrology.com/): Overview of Vedic & KP Astrology services, daily Panchang highlights, and featured tools.
- [About Pandit Rahul Bali Ji](https://baliastrology.com/about): Background, lineage, education, and astrological philosophy of Pandit Rahul Bali Ji.
- [Book Online Consultation](https://baliastrology.com/book-astrology-reading-online): Schedule a 1-hour live direct birth chart reading (₹701/- booking charge via UPI/PayPal).
- [Client Reviews](https://baliastrology.com/reviews): Authentic experiences and feedback from clients.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://baliastrology.com/faq): Answers to common questions regarding horoscope generation, KP astrology, and consultations.

## Free Astrological Tools

- [Free Kundli & Birth Chart](https://baliastrology.com/free-horoscope): Complete Vedic birth chart generation including Lagna chart, Navamsha (D9), Vimshottari Dasha, planetary positions, and house details.
- [KP Prashna / Horary Astrology](https://baliastrology.com/kp-horary): KP Horary analysis using a horary number (1-249) for specific timing and query predictions.
- [Daily Panchang](https://baliastrology.com/panchang): Real-time daily Vedic calendar including Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Rahu Kalam, and Abhijit Muhurta.
- [Planetary Hours (Hora)](https://baliastrology.com/hora): Planetary Hora calculations throughout the day for selecting auspicious timing.
- [Planetary Transits (Gochar)](https://baliastrology.com/transits): Interactive tracker for live and future planetary transits across signs and Nakshatras.
- [Transits Table](https://baliastrology.com/transits-table): Compact real-time summary table of current planetary positions, lords, and motion states.
- [Panch Pakshi](https://baliastrology.com/panch-pakshi): South Indian Pancha Pakshi Shastra calculations for daily activity states based on birth Nakshatra.
- [Biorhythm Calculator](https://baliastrology.com/biorhythm): Physical, emotional, and intellectual cycles based on birth date.
- [Birth Time Rectification (BTR)](https://baliastrology.com/btr): Tool assisting in refining precise birth timing using astrological indicators.

## Blog & Articles

- [Blog Index](https://baliastrology.com/blog): Articles on Vedic astrology, KP system, planetary movements, and remedies.
- [Navigating Planetary Transits](https://baliastrology.com/blog/navigating-planetary-transits): Detailed guide on understanding planetary transits (Gochar) and their impact.
- [KP Astrology Demystified](https://baliastrology.com/blog/kp-astrology-demystified): Fundamentals of Krishnamurti Paddhati, sub-lords, and precise event timing.
- [Understanding Panchang](https://baliastrology.com/blog/understanding-panchang): Explanation of the five limbs of Panchang and how to choose auspicious Muhurtas.
